autoCompleteNotReady: Available once a foundation builds past the deal
playing: Move cards to build the foundations

tutorial.foundation: There are two sets of foundations. The ascending row starts with the four Aces and builds A to K by suit. The descending row starts empty and opens when you play a King, then builds K down to A.
tutorial.tableau: The other 48 cards are dealt face-up into 13 columns (four of three cards, nine of four). Only the last card of a column can be moved.
tutorial.moves: A card can be stacked on another of the same suit exactly one rank away, up or down. An emptied column is not a free parking space.
tutorial.controls: Use hint, undo, and auto-complete buttons.

hintReason.toAce: Send this card to the ascending foundation to shorten the column.
hintReason.toKing: Send this card to the descending foundation to shorten the column.
hintReason.toTableau: Apply the suggested tableau move to dig out the cards underneath.
